title: Generic defaults pack (technology costs, finance defaults, illustrative tariffs, synthetic load profiles)

campus_equipment.rows: one `investment` part per entry: overnight (capex_eur, capex_eur_per_km for a cable, per bay for switchgear), lifetime (lifetime_a), fom_share (opex_frac)
campus_equipment.reference: docs/superpowers/research/2026-10-12-campus-asset-reference-costs.md (cited reference costs: Ei Normvärdeslista elnät 2024-2027, Danish Energy Agency Technology Data for Energy Transport; 2022 SEK to 2025 EUR at the ECB rate and the euro-area C27.1 producer price index); a value without a source stays assumed (illustrative)

template_technologies.rows: one `investment` part per MW: overnight, fom_share, lifetime and (except onwind) efficiency, in 2025 EUR (technology-data's eur_year); gas-genset ← OCGT, diesel-genset ← oil, onwind ← onwind, fuel-cell ← fuel cell, electrolysis ← electrolysis
template_technologies.why: IC S3 seeds (owner 2026-10-13, Q1 a): the Energy Hub templates and redundancy placeholders derive their costs from the pack

ammonia_technologies.rows: one `investment` part each: overnight, fom_share, lifetime, in 2025 EUR (technology-data's eur_year); haber-bosch ← Haber-Bosch (per MW of NH3), nh3-tank ← NH3 (l) storage tank incl. liquefaction, h2-tank ← hydrogen storage tank type 1 including compressor
ammonia_technologies.why: grid-to-process ticket 05: the ammonia tracer template eh_ammonia_staged prices its tanks from the pack; the Haber-Bosch loop is a sunk, fixed-size unit whose rows serve the investment case. The Haber-Bosch electricity input (0.2473 MWh_el/MWh_NH3) is a template number, ledgered there

heat_technologies.library_version: technology-data v0.14.0 (eur_year 2025) and the Danish Energy Agency catalogues it ships
heat_technologies.rows: one `investment` part each: overnight, fom_share, lifetime, efficiency (a COP for the heat pump) and the operating range the source states (min_load, temperatures); electric-boiler-steam <- electric boiler steam (DEA 310.1), industrial-heat-pump-ht <- industrial heat pump high temperature (DEA 302.b), both from costs_2030.csv in 2025 EUR; electric-process-heater <- DEA 312.c Direct firing, Electricity, 2019 EUR; thermal-storage-molten-salt <- DEA 143b Molten salt Carnot battery (industrial steam), 2020 EUR
heat_technologies.why: refinery electrification gap 2 (.scratch/grid-to-process/research/se-electrifying-refining-desw024.md section 6a.3): library rows for the electrified heat technologies

load_profiles.label: Commercial office (synthetic shape)
load_profiles.source: synthetic: guided investment study S4, a stated shape (weekday 08-18 plateau, night and weekend base, summer cooling uplift), not a measurement
load_profiles.note: Scaled to the intake's annual MWh; replace with a metered load to leave screening maturity.

load_profiles.label: Industrial, two shifts (synthetic shape)
load_profiles.source: synthetic: guided investment study S4, a stated shape (weekday 06-22 two shifts, night and weekend base, August and December shutdown dips), not a measurement
load_profiles.note: Scaled to the intake's annual MWh; replace with a metered load to leave screening maturity.

typed_cost_units.why: GS-2b: capacity_basis, includes_grid_connection and money_year on every row; same numbers as 2026-10-20
typed_cost_units.includes_grid_connection: campus equipment false; technology-data v0.14.0 rows "unknown" (the v0.14 text does not state it per row)

campus_reference_costs.why: campus-IC 03A: the 243 campus equipment rows (overnight, lifetime, fom_share of 81 entries) take the cited reference costs in 2025 EUR; every other row, the finance defaults, tariffs and load profiles are 2026-10-22's unchanged

heat_technologies.why: 21 new rows; every 2026-10-23 row, the finance defaults, tariffs and load profiles are unchanged

money_year_relabel.why: owner decision MONEY-YEAR-1: technology-data v0.14.0 states eur_year 2025 (config.yaml), so its outputs/costs_2030.csv is in 2025 EUR; the CSV's currency_year column is the year each source was inflated from
money_year_relabel.change: money_year 2020 -> 2025 on these rows only; every value, every other row (the DEA-workbook rows keep their sheet's year), the finance defaults, tariffs and load profiles are unchanged

money_year_conversion.why: owner decision MONEY-YR-SEED-1: the guided study reads the 2025 technology-data rows (pack 2026-10-25) and `currency_year_mixed` refuses a 2020 tariff against them, so the illustrative seed tariffs are converted to 2025 EUR
money_year_conversion.index: Eurostat prc_hicp_aind, HICP all items, annual average rate of change, European Economic Area (EEA), 2021-2025, as vendored by technology-data v0.14.0 at inputs/prc_hicp_aind__custom_20097956_spreadsheet.xlsx
money_year_conversion.change: the two tariffs: every money figure x 1.2573346011408 (not rounded), currency_year and valid_from 2020 -> 2025; finance.yaml currency_year 2020 -> 2025; every values.csv row, the finance defaults' values and the load profiles are unchanged
